module savings.schedule
  purpose: Print a yearly savings balance schedule with compound interest.

import std.environment
import std.console

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, environment
  purpose: Read command-line arguments and print the savings schedule.

  let args be environment.arguments()
  if args.length is not 3 then
    console.print_error("Usage: savings <starting_amount> <yearly_rate_percent> <years>")
    environment.exit(code: 1)
  end

  let starting_amount_text be args.at(0) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "missing starting amount")
  let rate_percent_text be args.at(1) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "missing rate percent")
  let years_text be args.at(2) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "missing years")

  let starting_amount be starting_amount_text.to_decimal() otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "invalid starting amount")
  let rate_percent be rate_percent_text.to_decimal() otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "invalid rate percent")
  let years be years_text.to_integer() otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "invalid years")

  if starting_amount is less than 0 then
    fail with AppError(detail: "starting amount must be non-negative")
  end
  if rate_percent is less than 0 then
    fail with AppError(detail: "rate percent must be non-negative")
  end
  if years is less than 0 then
    fail with AppError(detail: "years must be non-negative")
  end

  console.print("Year,Balance")
  let rate_decimal be rate_percent / 100
  let mutable balance be starting_amount
  let mutable year be 0

  repeat until year is greater than years
    let formatted_balance be format_currency(balance)
    console.print("{year},{formatted_balance}")
    set balance to balance * (1 + rate_decimal)
    set year to year + 1
  end
end

function format_currency(amount: Decimal) returns Text
  purpose: Format a decimal amount as currency with two decimal places.
  example: format_currency(amount: 1234.5) is "1234.50"

  let rounded be amount.rounded(places: 2)
  let text be rounded.to_text()
  let parts be text.split(separator: ".")
  let integer_part be parts.at(0) otherwise fail
  let decimal_part be
    if parts.length is 2 then
      let part be parts.at(1) otherwise fail
      if part.length is 1 then
        part + "0"
      otherwise
        part
      end
    otherwise
      "00"
    end
  return integer_part + "." + decimal_part
end

public type AppError
  purpose: An error that occurred during execution.
  has detail: Text
end

function calculate_balance(principal: Decimal, rate_percent: Decimal)
  returns Decimal
  purpose: Calculate the balance after one year of compound interest.
  example: calculate_balance(principal: 1000.00, rate_percent: 5.0) is 1050.00

  let rate be rate_percent / 100
  return principal * (1 + rate)
end

public type AppError
  purpose: An error that occurred during program execution.
  has detail: Text
end

module savings.schedule

import std.environment
import std.console

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, environment
  purpose: Read command-line arguments and print the savings schedule.

  let args be environment.arguments()
  if args.length is not 3 then
    console.print_error("Usage: savings <starting_amount> <yearly_rate_percent> <years>")
    environment.exit(code: 1)
  end

  let starting_amount_text be args.at(0) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "missing starting amount")
  let rate_percent_text be args.at(1) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "missing rate percent")
  let years_text be args.at(2) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "missing years")

  let starting_amount be starting_amount_text.to_decimal() otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "invalid starting amount")
  let rate_percent be rate_percent_text.to_decimal() otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "invalid rate percent")
  let years be years_text.to_integer() otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "invalid years")

  if starting_amount is less than 0 then
    fail with AppError(detail: "starting amount must be non-negative")
  end
  if rate_percent is less than 0 then
    fail with AppError(detail: "rate percent must be non-negative")
  end
  if years is less than 0 then
    fail with AppError(detail: "years must be non-negative")
  end

  console.print("Year,Balance")
  let mutable balance be starting_amount
  let mutable year be 0
  repeat until year is greater than years
    let formatted_balance be format_currency(balance)
    console.print("{year},{formatted_balance}")
    if year is less than years then
      let rate_decimal be rate_percent / 100
      set balance to balance * (1 + rate_decimal)
    end
    set year to year + 1
  end
end

function format_currency(amount: Decimal) returns Text
  purpose: Format a decimal amount as currency with two decimal places.
  example: format_currency(amount: 1234.5) is "1234.50"

  let rounded be amount.rounded(places: 2)
  let text be rounded.to_text()
  let parts be text.split(separator: ".")
  if parts.length is 2 then
    let integer_part be parts.at(0) otherwise fail
    let decimal_part be parts.at(1) otherwise fail
    if decimal_part.length is 1 then
      return "{integer_part}.{decimal_part}0"
    otherwise
      return text
    end
  otherwise
    return "{text}.00"
  end
end

public type AppError
  purpose: An error that occurred during program execution.
  has detail: Text
end
